findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 15 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. Serosal invasion, retropancreatic tissue invasion, and extrapancreatic nerve plexus invasion are noted. No other local invasion factors are identified. No lymph node metastases are present. No other metastases are observed.
